items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps dry-feeling skin comfortable while you start a retinol.
The lower-strength 0.3% retinol is a gentle starting point for smoother-looking texture and more even-looking tone.
A rich ceramide cream supports a low moisture score and helps the skin tolerate a new retinol.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides is needed daily with retinol and suits deeper skin tones without a chalky cast.

response.routine_note: Use the retinol at night just 2 nights a week at first, applied after cleansing and followed by the cream, then add nights slowly as your skin feels comfortable. Apply the sunscreen every morning, and skip other exfoliating acids while you settle in.
